question: Which of the following is a famous folk dance of Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rangabati.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rangabati**​

 
 
• **Rangabati is a famous folk dance of Odisha.**
 
• The most well-known recorded song in **Sambalpuri/Odiya is probably "Rangabati."**
 
• The song's male singer is 2017 **Padma Shri recipient Jitendra Haripal.** In the middle of the 1970s, the song was initially recorded for All India Radio.
 
• The song was redone in 1976 by the **Indian Record Manufacturing Company Ltd (INRECO), **a record label based in Calcutta at the time. The disc was finally published in 1978–1979 after a dispute caused a delay.
 
• **Mitrabhanu Gauntia wrote the Sambalpuri song**, which was performed by Jitendra Haripal and Krishna Patel and was produced by Prabhudatta Pradhan.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Folk Dance of Odisha**

 
 
• Various folk dance styles emerged in various parts of **Odisha**, including the well-known **Odissi and Chhau.**
 
• Many people adore the **Sambalpuri dance**, which is the most well-known dance in western Odisha.
 
• Some coastal areas of Odisha, including **Cuttack, Jajapur, Jagatsinghpur, Puri, Khurda, Bhadrak, Baleswar, Dhenkanal, and Angul, practise the dance style known as Laudi Khela, also known as Gauda Nacha.**
 
• The performers are mostly young boys from the "Gauda" or "Gopal" (Yadav) castes. During Dola Purnima, this dance is performed (Holi).
 
• One of Odisha's most popular and well-known folk dance styles is called Ghumura Dance (or Ghumra Dance).
